question: In which state was the first jute mill of India set up?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first jute mill in India was set up in West Bengal in the city of Rishra.**
 
• It was established by **George Acland and John Marshall in the year 1855.**
 
• The jute industry grew rapidly in West Bengal due to the availability of raw jute and the proximity to the ports of Kolkata and Howrah.
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is option 2 - West Bengal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - Odisha has a significant jute industry, but the first jute mill was not set up in this state.
 
• Option 3 - Assam also has a jute industry, but the first jute mill was not set up in this state.
 
• Option 4 - Bihar does not have a significant jute industry, and the first jute mill was not set up in this state.
